name: GSM Foils Ltd.
summary: GSM Foils Ltd. is an India-based packaging materials manufacturing company that specializes in producing blister foils and aluminum pharma foils. The company's primary products include plain, printed, coated, and poly-laminated foils, as well as strip foils, alu-alu foils, and lid foils, designed for high abrasion resistance, tensile strength, durability, bond strength, and superior sealing. These foils, available in various micron thicknesses, are primarily used in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries for packaging medicinal products like capsules and tablets, protecting them from environmental factors such as moisture, light, and oxygen. Operating on a business-to-business (B2B) model, GSM Foils sources high-quality raw materials and focuses on customized printing and coating solutions to meet stringent regulatory and safety standards for medical packaging. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and is committed to timely delivery and competitive pricing.
